source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The editor controller implements getCommandStateWithParams and doCommandWithParams by calling the registered command object’s getCommandStateParams and doCommandParams with the command and params. The smile menu uses this route: goDoCommandParams stores the selected face in state_attribute, and nsSetSmiley reads it before insertHTML. Ordinary doCommand is a different path. Keep the adapter method names, receiver and parameter object aligned when replacing controller machinery. The added test focuses the editor and asserts the inserted face in a paragraph; it does not directly cover every parameter command, focus restoration or accessibility behavior. No browser test ran.
title: Compose parameter commands must reach the registered command object
